stem.text: Which row correctly matches each cell structure with its function?

A.text: allow vesicles to move within the cell; synthesises amino acids

B.text: form cilia and centrioles; produces ribosomes

C.text: form the spindle during prophase; transports proteins

D.text: move chromosomes during anaphase; makes triglycerides and phospholipids

A: allow vesicles to move within the cell
